ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** with a library of a few hundred moments, open Chronicle's Map, then Walks, then Days; open a replay while the map is still loading and come back. **Expect:** each section shows its walks, finds and pins; the view you left is kept on the way back; the three reads (`listChecklistAreas`, `listFinds`, `momentsBetween`), now run together on the one SQLite connection, all answer (fix chronicle-focus-reload).
